facts.heading: Serving Houston since 1946
facts.text: Village Plumbing, Air & Electric has been part of the Houston community for more than 80 years. Very few companies in the area can match that kind of longevity. Our history in the region means we understand the challenges Houston homes face. Founded in 1946, our company has grown alongside the Houston metro area while staying true to a simple principle: treat customers with honesty, respect, and professionalism on every service call.

facts.heading: How long your systems last
items: Most central AC systems give you 12 to 15 years, though Houston humidity and the long season take a toll.
A standard water heater tank should see you through 8 to 12 years.
A thermostat can last 10 years or more, but many homeowners upgrade sooner for better control and energy savings.
An AC system more than 10 to 15 years old, or constantly breaking down, may be due for replacement.

facts.heading: Frequently asked questions
items: Why is my water pressure low through the whole house? More often than not the main line, a pressure regulator that has had its day, corrosion or a leak you cannot see.

How do I know if there is a hidden leak? Watch for a spike in the bill, dampness, a mildew scent, or the sound of running water with all the taps shut. We find leaks in walls or under the house without making a mess.
Does Houston's hard water hurt my plumbing? The minerals clog pipes, mark fixtures and shorten the life of your heater. A softener or filtration system is the answer.
What is hydro jetting? Snaking punches a hole in the clog. Hydro jetting puts high-pressure water to work scouring the pipe wall, far more effective against roots and grease.
Why do I keep getting clogs? Usually grease, hair or tree roots further down the line. Leave the store-bought products alone.
What are the signs of sewer line trouble? Multiple slow drains, gurgling toilets or the smell of sewage. We run a camera down the line before recommending anything.
Why won't my breaker stay on? It is tripping to head off a fire or overheating. An electrician can tell you if it is a short, an overloaded circuit or a bad breaker.
When is it time to update the electrical panel? Flickering lights, a box that is warm or buzzing, or living with extension cords.
Do I need whole-house surge protection? We would say yes. One of our storms can send a surge through the grid and wreck what is plugged in.

Why does it smell like burning when I turn the heat on? Dust from the summer burning off the components. If you smell something electrical or it hangs in the air for over a minute, turn it off and call us.
Heat pump or furnace? A heat pump is efficient and handles the cooling as well, but a furnace has more oomph when it is really cold.
When should I book AC service? In the spring, before the heat becomes oppressive. An annual checkup is key for longevity here.
What if I have a burst pipe? Shut off the main valve to stop the flood and get in touch. Our 24-hour service is always on.
